_comment: Multilingual HARD case: the compound SL-vs-EL comparison (the question that took three runs to pass in English), now asked in Hindi and Kannada too. Four dimensions x two leave types = eight facts that must be gathered across chunks AND translated. Check the numbers survive intact: SL 7 days / accumulation capped at 15 / no encashment / medical certificate at 3+ consecutive days; EL 21 days / credited monthly / balance above 30 encashed each January. Also check the EL medical line is phrased as 'the policy does not state' rather than 'not required' -- that exact phrasing is what the verifier rejected in run 3, and translation is a fresh chance to lose it.
_field_notes: Optional per-question fields, added for the precision@10/recall@10 and robustness checks: 'expected_type' is one of 'off_topic' (should get the fixed out-of-scope refusal), 'uncovered' (should get the disclosed general-knowledge fallback), or 'covered' (should get a real grounded, cited answer) — omitted where genuinely ambiguous so the harness skips grading those rather than guessing. 'relevant_document_names' is document-level ground truth for precision/recall — only set where the content is confidently expected to come from that document.

questions.question: Compare sick leave and earned leave in terms of annual entitlement, carry-forward, encashment, and medical requirements.
सिक लीव और अर्न्ड लीव की तुलना करें — वार्षिक अधिकार, कैरी-फॉरवर्ड, इनकैशमेंट और मेडिकल सर्टिफिकेट की शर्तों के संदर्भ में।
ಅನಾರೋಗ್ಯ ರಜೆ ಮತ್ತು ಗಳಿಸಿದ ರಜೆಯನ್ನು ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ಹಕ್ಕು, ಮುಂದಿನ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ ಒಯ್ಯುವುದು (carry forward), ನಗದೀಕರಣ ಮತ್ತು ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಪತ್ರದ ಅಗತ್ಯಗಳ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಯಿಂದ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ.
